fields.label: Backup Plan
fields.help: A reference to the BackupPlan from which Backups may be used as the source for Restores created via this RestorePlan.

fields.label: Cluster
fields.help: The name of the target cluster to which you want to Restore via this RestorePlan.

fields.label: Deletion Policy
fields.help: Whether Terraform will be prevented from destroying the instance.

fields.label: Description
fields.help: User specified descriptive string for this RestorePlan.

fields.help: The region of the Restore Plan.

fields.label: Name
fields.help: The full name of the BackupPlan Resource.

fields.label: Restore Config
All Namespaces
fields.help: If True, restore all namespaced resources in the Backup.

fields.help: Defines the behavior for handling the situation where cluster-scoped resources being restored already exist in the target cluster.

fields.label: Namespaced Resource Restore Mode
fields.help: Defines the behavior for handling the situation where sets of namespaced resources being restored already exist in the target cluster.

fields.label: No Namespaces
fields.help: Do not restore any namespaced resources if set to "True".

fields.label: Volume Data Restore Policy
fields.help: Specifies the mechanism to be used to restore volume data.
